data_provenance.research: Consolidated recorded research from preceding conversation; no new web recrawl during file packaging
data_provenance.extracted_text_semantics: Research evidence excerpts/paraphrases, not a guaranteed verbatim snapshot
data_provenance.original_rule_ids: Active rule IDs regenerated after reconciliation; superseded filled baseline records archived below

selection.basis: Preserved bank/public-bank/NBFC shortlist from uploaded lenders.csv

status_definitions.VERIFIED_OFFICIAL: Observed statement on an official lender source in recorded research; publication evidence is not unconditional applicability, completeness or approval.
status_definitions.UNKNOWN: Not established from usable evidence; blank active value.
status_definitions.CONFLICTING: Relevant statements disagree; blank active value.
status_definitions.CONDITIONAL: Summary depends on product/applicant category or an unresolved mapping; inspect detailed scoped rules.
status_definitions.INCOME_BASIS_UNCLEAR: Published number exists but income basis is not explicit; not safe to substitute gross or net.
status_definitions.OFFICIAL_BLOG_OBSERVATION: Official explanatory content; lower authority than applicable dated schedule/KFS/contract.
status_definitions.VERIFIED_SECONDARY: Third-party or secondary-source evidence; not an automatic hard rejection rule.
status_definitions.ESTIMATED: Explicit model assumption, not lender policy.
status_definitions.OBSERVED_IN_CALCULATOR: Calculator observation; does not establish a contractual bound.

availability_policy.SOURCING_UNAVAILABLE: Exclude current recommendations; retain published data for audit.
availability_policy.LIVE_OFFER_NOT_VERIFIED: Public product evidence exists; current live personalised offer not verified.

global_affordability_assumption.basis: Retained baseline project scenario assumption, not a newly verified universal lender rule

amount_calculation.label: Illustrative affordability estimate, never lender sanction
